sloka: मम अयम् आत्मप्रभवो भूयस्त्वम् उपयास्यति ।अदृश्यमाना वैदेही शोकम् वर्धयती इह मे ॥४-१-३४॥
transliteration: mama ayam ātmaprabhavo bhūyastvam upayāsyati ।adṛśyamānā vaidehī śokam vardhayatī iha me ॥4-1-34॥

translations.english: 'When in place of Vaidehi I see spring (with its cool breeze) that used to take away the sweat generated by sensual enjoyment, my sorrow is intensified.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! यदि इस प्रकार का दूत राजा के पास न रहे, तो राजाओं के काये क्यों कर सिद्ध हों !
